review.notes: Full review. All nine findings of the previous review are repaired or settled by the pin. Three P2 findings: 0.5 converse construction lacks the condition b_n -> infinity of Wintenberger 1983 Rem. 1.4.2 (counterexample over F_2((t))); 4.2 states Wintenberger 2004 Prop. 2 with epsilon^{Z_p} where epsilon^{Q_p} is right (counterexample epsilon^{1/p}); the definition of e(Gamma) opening Layer 4 omits 'wildly ramified' (counterexample with e = 1/p). Sample of 15 targets chosen by the reviewer (0.2-0.6, 1.2-1.6, 2.1-2.2, 3.1-3.4, 4.1-4.4, 5.1-5.2) read against Wintenberger 1983, Wintenberger 2004, Abrashkin 2010 and Keating 2009; Tate 1967 and Sen 1972 uncertified. 22 library declarations opened at the pins, 14 cross-roadmap citations resolved. Suggested.lean elaborates with three sorry warnings only; #check on all six declarations, no binder lost; one-tactic probe closes none. Dependency check: 0 problems. Automatic checks pass except the form check on target headings (format note).
